name: FREE Walk-Up Paddling – 2nd St.
why: Drop by the boathouse to launch a canoe for a free, self-guided paddle on the Gowanus Canal (10am-2pm). A quirky, low-key July 4th outing.

name: FREE Walk-Up Paddling – 2nd St.

name: Brooklyn Navy Yard: Past, Present & Future Walking Tour
why: Turnstile's flagship walking tour of the historic-and-active Brooklyn Navy Yard, offered every Saturday at 2pm. A behind-the-scenes look at how the Yard works today.
